  "component_id": "BAY-02",

  "decision_summary": [
    "Visual evidence confirms green LED on SRV-001 BAY-02, which per manual normally implies healthy SMART.",
    "Telemetry shows SMART Status=warning with 34 pending sectors and 0 reallocated sectors, contradicting 100% healthy claim.",
    "Kernel log independently corroborates 34 pending sectors during background scrubbing.",
    "Manual rule for pending>0 with reallocations=0 requires extended surface scan to distinguish transient soft errors from physical defect.",
    "Discriminating surface scan has not been executed, so health cannot be confirmed and failure cannot be confirmed."
  ],
  "device_id": "SRV-001",
  "incident_id": "INC-SRV-001-BAY-02",
  "missing_information": "Extended diagnostic surface scan per MAN-TELEMETRY-01 and MAN-DIAG-01 not yet executed; post-scan pending sector count, reallocated sector count, and unrecoverable read errors unknown.",
  "reasoning": "Technician asked if drive with green LED is 100% healthy. Pixel analysis and vision model confirm green LED (EV-IMG-SRV001_BAY02_GREEN, EV-IMG-SRV001_BAY02_GREEN-VISION). Per MAN-LED-01 solid green signifies normal activity with healthy SMART telemetry. However SMART telemetry reports Status=warning with CurrentPendingSectors=34, ReallocatedSectors=0, PredictiveFailure=CLEARED, RAID=optimal (EV-TEL-SRV001-BAY02-S1). Event log EVT-NVME-MEDIA-WARN corroborates 34 pending sectors during scrubbing (EV-LOG-SRV001-0001). Per MAN-TELEMETRY-01, when pending is elevated while reallocated remains zero, instability may be soft read errors rather than physical defect and an extended diagnostic surface scan must be executed; if scan clears pending to zero with zero reallocations drive is cleared safe, replacement only if reallocations increase or errors persist. Per MAN-DIAG-01 extended surface scans require 30-120 minutes. Since this discriminating test has not been run, pending sectors alone do not confirm media failure and abnormal telemetry precludes not_confirmed. Status is more_evidence_required.",
  "recommended_action": "Request authorization to run extended surface scan (surface_sector_verification) on SRV-001 BAY-02; do not replace drive at this time. If scan clears pending to zero with zero reallocations, drive is verified safe to remain in service; if reallocations increase or unrecoverable errors persist, initiate replacement under approval.",
  "status": "more_evidence_required",
  "summary": "SRV-001 BAY-02 shows green LED but is not verified 100% healthy; SMART warning with 34 pending sectors and 0 reallocations requires extended surface scan to exclude physical defect.",
  "supporting_evidence_ids": [
    "EV-TEL-SRV001-BAY02-S1",
    "EV-LOG-SRV001-0001",
    "MAN-TELEMETRY-01",
    "MAN-DIAG-01",
    "MAN-LED-01"
  ]
}
